notes.title: Release Notes - 2025/03/11 New Settings Minor Updates
notes.notes:
[h2]New Settings Added[/h2]

[b]Added Toggle / Hold Setting for Grip Button[/b]

While piloting the Runner, throttle and control stick operations are performed using the controller’s grip button. Previously, only toggle operation was available, but now you can choose to use hold operation as well.

You can enable or disable the toggle function in the settings menu by checking or unchecking the "Toggle Grip Button" option. (The default setting is enabled.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111780/ee1a61b37cc471e986b2da7281f87e8401ea506d.png[/img]


[b]Added Self-Destruct Warning for Moving Too Far from the Runner[/b]
If the player moves more than 300m away from their Runner, they will self-destruct. Previously, this happened without any warning.

With this update, a warning will now appear on the screen when the player reaches 300m away from 
their Runner, and they will self-destruct after 15 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111780/b99278586c115723dd258049665860cad38bf4b9.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Notes - 2025/03/04 New features & Bug fixes Minor Updates
notes.notes:
[h2]New features[/h2]

[b]Seek bar and Play/Stop function added to video tutorial panel[/b]

Videos in the Video Tutorial panel can now be played back at any time using the seek bar!
You can also Play/Stop videos by aiming the video and pulling the trigger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111780/32555826ec2dad4a2bbd5061c5b957157b0ccb77.png[/img]

[b]Changes to the suicide button[/b]

The suicide button had many reports of accidental presses, as it was possible to suicide with one click!
The suicide button now adds a grace period before suicide! (5seconds)
When you press the suicide button, a slider appears on the screen and you have to hold the button down for a 5seconds to suicide!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111780/657ea832dabddc0c1a537c21d2a817b9ea16877a.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[b]Introduce a countermeasure to a problem that Quest3 JoyStick may not respond in certain situations[/b]

We have not yet found the cause, we modified the code that takes the directional judgement of the controller's joystick.

notes.title: "Steel Runner" Demo Released on Steam🎉
notes.notes:
[b]🚀 VR Vehicle Crafting & Combat Game "Steel Runner" Demo Released! 🚀[/b]

On February 25, 2025 (Tue),  "Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox" demo has been released on Steam! 🎉
You can download it for free from the "Download Demo" button on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2855870/Steel_Runner__VR_Block_Craft_Sandbox/]store page[/url], so be sure to give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111780/9b44a33f78b2c879e05fd389184ce95a86f69d8c.png[/img]

[b]🔧 What You Can Experience in the Demo 🔧[/b]

You can try out the core features of the game, including building your own Runner (vehicle), engaging in battles, and exploring a vast world.
Some blocks, functions, and maps are available in advance, giving you a glimpse of what’s to come in the Early Access version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111780/39dc21377fcbfc645df4f8ffde680746fe676bd5.png[/img]

[b]💬 We Want Your Feedback! 💬[/b]

Your feedback on the demo will help us improve the game for future updates and the Early Access release.
Please share your thoughts through Steam reviews or on Discord!


👉 Steam Store Page

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2855870/Steel_Runner__VR_Block_Craft_Sandbox/
